title: Betrayal or Business? Unpacking Trump’s Diesel Deal with Russia
gist: Podcast episode notes only: a new Trump-Putin diesel deal drew criticism at home and abroad, and Zelensky called it a betrayal. Oil analyst Rory Johnston is brought on to explain what the deal does and how much it could change the war; the substance is not in the text.

insights.claim: President Trump's new diesel deal with President Putin drew swift criticism from US lawmakers and allies abroad, and Ukraine's Zelensky called it a betrayal.
insights.speaker: War on the Rocks
insights.so_what: Political backlash raises the odds the deal is constrained or reversed, relevant to Russian diesel flows.

insights.claim: Oil is the backbone of Russia's wartime economy and a prime target of Ukraine's recent drone strikes on Russian refineries.
insights.speaker: War on the Rocks
insights.so_what: Russian refinery output and diesel exports are a driver of diesel cracks and war financing.
